changeSet.author: VivekRamanavar
changeSet.comment: usp_GetEmployee: returns EmpId, EmpName, DepartmentName for a given EmpId; all records when NULL is passed.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE `usp_GetEmployee` (IN p_EmpId INT) BEGIN SELECT e.`EmpId`, e.`EmpName`, d.`DepartmentName` FROM `Employee` e LEFT JOIN `Department` d ON d.`DepartmentId` = e.`DepartmentId` WHERE (p_EmpId IS NULL OR e.`EmpId` = p_EmpId); END
